messages:
Priya (Solutions): kicking off NovaRetail pilot. request from their product lead: 3 core flows (category search rewrite, FAQ assistant, order-summary extraction). need: prompt inventory, baseline outputs, success metrics, timing, and any enterprise blockers (security/pricing). can we align by EOD tomorrow? :calendar: 
Jordan (AE): thanks — customer expects a 4-week pilot, want SLA for peak traffic (spike to ~60 qps). also asked about on-prem option if we need to keep logs in their VPC.
Priya (Solutions): noted. main ask for engineering: a quick baseline run for each flow with our hosted model + a quantized dedicated variant so they can compare latency/cost.
Alex (Eng): I can run baseline on a small shard. need sample prompts + avg token lengths per flow. also confirm whether kv-cache/caching is allowed for customer data.
Priya (Solutions): prompt inventory (working list):
- category_search: 8 prompts (user query -> rewritten query for search ranker) avg input 18 tokens, expect rewrite length ~10 tokens
- faq_assistant: 12 prompts (multi-turn clarifying + short answer) avg input 60 tokens, expected output 40-120 tokens
- order_extract: 6 prompts (structured extraction into JSON schema) avg input 140 tokens, outputs ~80 tokens (JSON)
Can we use that to run the baseline?
Leo (ML): good. I'll add a small eval harness with these eval metrics: latency p50/p95, token cost per call, accuracy for extraction (F1), and human-graded helpfulness for FAQ (1-5).
Sam (CS): for success criteria customer wants: 
- FAQ helpfulness >= 4.0 on 50 sample dialogs
- category rewrite precision @1 >= 85% on 200 samples
- order_extract F1 >= 92% on 150 receipts
If we hit these, they convert to Dedicated.
Priya (Solutions): timeline proposal:
- today: confirm prompt inventory + sample data (customer to drop into shared folder)
- +48h: eng runs hosted baseline + cost/latency numbers
- +5 days: ML runs evals + qualitative samples for customer review
- +12 days: joint demo + rollout plan and pricing proposal
Jordan (AE): pricing Q: can we show an estimated per-100k-token cost for hosted vs Dedicated reserved GPU (m4)? customer will compare to existing vendor.
Alex (Eng): estimate: hosted gen avg cost ~ $0.0022 per 1k tokens for that model; dedicated reserved depends on throughput. I'll get a committed monthly number once I know target qps.
Maria (Security): heads up on security questionnaire: NovaRetail marks order data as PII-sensitive, wants KMS-managed keys and option to disable caching. they also require SOC2 + logs retention controls. we'll need to map features: KMS integration (ok), caching toggle (we can disable prefix cache), and private deployment timeline (2-3 weeks for VPC prep).
Priya (Solutions): good to know. Maria, can you draft the short answers for their vendor security sheet? even the two-liner for KMS and logs?
Maria (Security): will do. also advise customer that disabling caching will increase cost/latency — share tradeoffs in doc.
Leo (ML): eval harness snippet I will run (example):
```
python eval_harness.py --model hosted/redwood-gpt-3 --dataset prompts/novaretail_faq.json --metrics latency,helpfulness
```
Will post raw CSVs to the shared folder.
Alex (Eng): for the dedicated baseline I'll spin up a small pool with quantized weights (int8). expect p50 ~ 70ms for short replies, p95 ~ 250ms depending on batch. will verify.
Priya (Solutions): blockers?
Jordan (AE): customer asks for an NDA addendum before sharing real PII samples. legal needs to sign — can we proceed with synthetic samples until NDA is in place?
Sam (CS): yes synthetic is fine for initial runs. we should prioritize order_extract on synthetic then re-run once NDA completes.
Priya (Solutions): action items: @Jordan get signed NDA or synthetic drop, @Alex run hosted + quant baseline within 48h, @Leo prepare eval harness and sample grading rubric, @Maria draft security answers, @Sam compile customer success criteria doc. I'll consolidate into a one-pager for the exec sponsor.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: baseline-environment v2 -> staging (ETA 40m).
Jordan (AE): thanks team. i'll ping the customer about synthetic dataset and timeline. :thumbsup:
Priya (Solutions): perfect — will follow up with calendar invite for the +5d demo.
